WITH team_averages AS (
    SELECT
        team_id,
        AVG(w) AS avg_wins,
        AVG(1.0 * (g - l) / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS avg_games_minus_losses_over_losses
    FROM manager_half
    GROUP BY team_id
),
with_mean AS (
    SELECT
        team_id,
        avg_wins,
        avg_games_minus_losses_over_losses,
        AVG(avg_wins) OVER () AS mean_team_avg_wins
    FROM team_averages
)
SELECT
    team_id,
    avg_wins,
    avg_games_minus_losses_over_losses,
    avg_wins - mean_team_avg_wins AS gap_above_mean
FROM with_mean
WHERE avg_wins > mean_team_avg_wins
ORDER BY gap_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The mean of all teams' average wins is the unweighted mean across team_id groups; NULL win values are ignored by AVG. A zero-loss record makes the ratio undefined and is ignored by AVG through NULLIF.
